Patients qualifying for financial assistance under this policy receive a 100% discount (i.e., free care).

asset_test.details: Footnote says other financial information such as assets and hospital charges may be considered; assets defined to include cash, investments, retirement funds, and equity in primary residence and real estate. Presumptive eligibility cases are exempt from the asset criteria.

evidence.quote: Other financial information such as assets and hospital charges may be considered.

residency.area: Miami-Dade County; Broward County (only for services at listed providers located in Broward); Palm Beach County; Monroe County north of mile marker 25. Alternatively, patients who received or need emergent or urgent services for an acute event.

evidence.quote: The allocation of BHSF financial assistance resources will be limited to patients who:

The Application Period begins on the date the care is provided and ends on the later of the 240th day after the date that the first post-discharge billing statement for the care is provided or at least 30 days after Baptist Health provides the individual with a written notice that sets a deadline after which extraordinary collection actions may be initiated.

presumptive_eligibility: Emergent and urgent uninsured patients may be presumed eligible for 100% assistance if deceased with no known estate, homeless, or determined eligible by an independent third-party vendor.
how_to_apply: Call a Financial Counselor at 786-596-6507 (Bethesda Hospitals: 561-737-7733 ext. 84671); mail to Baptist Health South Florida, Inc., P.O. Box 830880, Miami, FL 33283; or visit any hospital patient access department; website https://baptisthealth.net/patient-resources/billing-and-financial-assistance
warnings: Both income bands give a 100% discount, so free care extends to 300% FPL, but incomes are capped at $75,000 regardless of family size.
The 200-300% band is labeled 'Special needs financial assistance' and may be case-by-case (budget-dependent); the 'state or federally qualified' label applies to 200% FPL or less.
Special needs band also tied to discharge date: accounts with discharge date older than the same or preceding two fiscal years are classified as special needs.
Bethesda Hospitals East and West: policy applies only to Emergent and Urgent patients.
Policy does not apply to Express Care, Care on Demand, concierge practices, cosmetic surgery, or private-practicing physicians.
Insured patients generally excluded; policy applies to charges not covered by insurance, though exhausted-benefit charges and non-Medicaid-provider services can qualify.
Residency is alternatively satisfied by emergent/urgent acute event care.
Application window not counted exactly as a single number: 240 days or at least 30 days after the ECA notice, whichever is later.
Financial assistance may be denied if patient refuses to apply for Medicaid or exchange coverage.
